sourceEvidence.text: Bin continues Old English binne, used for a basket or feeding receptacle. A Celtic connection involving benna and a cart with a woven body is considered probable, not completely established. The historical container idea is relevant; a same-spelled ancient word meaning a point or summit is not evidence for the origin of the modern rubbish-container word.
